name: University of Otago
description: The University of Otago is a public research university in Dunedin, founded in 1869 as New Zealand's first university, with about 21,000 students. It is one of New Zealand's two medical schools and the only New Zealand university offering dentistry.
whyIncluded: Its MB ChB is on the Singapore Medical Council's list of registrable basic medical qualifications, and New Zealand is among the ten destinations with the most Singaporean students abroad (about 360 in the UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS; UNESCO is the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization) data for 2022-24).

livingCosts.summary: The university's own estimate for a single student in a university flat over a 40-week academic year: rent with utilities, food, personal costs and entertainment. Excludes medical and travel insurance.
livingCosts.notes: University of Otago 'Standard living costs' table (based on 2025 costs, single student, 40 weeks = one academic year), 'UniFlats standard room' column. Housing: rent $268/wk (48-week contract, gas/electricity/internet included) x 52/12. Food: $4,800 for 40 weeks = $120/wk x 52/12. Transport: not itemised, 0. Personal: personal costs $3,200 + entertainment $2,200 + accommodation activity/other fees $520 over 40 weeks = $148/wk x 52/12. Excludes medical and travel insurance ($855). Otago's totals: UniFlats $24,439, residential college $27,192 for 40 weeks; it recommends NZ$22,000-$27,000. otago.ac.nz blocks automated access (Cloudflare challenge); the page was read on 2026-09-30 through a text rendering (r.jina.ai) of the official URL.

Official page read on 2026-09-30 through a text rendering (r.jina.ai) because otago.ac.nz blocks automated access. 2026 feeHistory row (spreadsheet sheet '2026 Papers'): per-paper basis, 120 points = 8 x 15-point (0.125 EFTS) LLM papers at $5,746.00 each (e.g. LAWS512; fee category IN21). The '2026 Thesis' sheet states the same $45,968.00 for LAWS5F Master of Laws Thesis, full-time full-year. Compulsory $1,193 = 2026 Dunedin Student Services Fee. Last verified 2026-10-04. otago.ac.nz blocks automated access, so the xlsx was read on 2026-10-04 through the reader proxy (r.jina.ai) of this URL. 2024/2025 rows use the same per-paper method as the existing 2026 row, from Otago's per-paper fee spreadsheets for those years (the live asset slot 508756 now serves 2026): '2024-domestic-and-international-tuition-fees.xlsx' (Wayback capture 20240203221503; it has 'International fee' and 'International fee (Grandparented)' columns, and the first, non-grandparented column is used for a new entrant) and '2025-domestic-and-international-tuition-fees-web-version.xlsx' (Wayback capture 20250325224014, linked from the March 2025 International tuition fees page as 'Download the 2025 domestic and international paper fees document'). Both were read on 2026-10-05 through Google Docs viewer's PDF rendering of the Wayback copy, because the Wayback relay will not pass binary files. Compulsory = Dunedin Student Services Fee for 1 EFTS: 2024 '$10.76 per 0.01 EFTS or $1,076.00 per 1 EFTS' (Otago Study/Fees page, Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2024-22 capture 2024-05-21); 2025 '$11.52 per 0.01 EFTS, which amounts to $1,152.00 for 1 EFTS' (otago.ac.nz/study/fees/student-services-fee, Wayback 20250325224013). Tuition: 8 x 15-point LLM papers (IN21; LAWS512 Family Law in 2024 at $5,261.88, LAWS547/548/588 in 2025 at $5,472.38) = $42,095.04 and $43,779.04; the thesis sheet gives LAWS5F Master of Laws Thesis full-time full-year at $42,095.00 (2024) and $43,779.00 (2025).

programmes.name: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MB ChB)
programmes.summary: Year 1 (Health Sciences First Year) costs about NZ$45,415. Years 2 and 3 cost about NZ$101,567 a year and years 4 to 6 about NZ$116,080 a year, so the six-year total is about NZ$596,800. Student services fee included.
programmes.notes: First-year rate: 2027 international fee for Health Sciences First Year (126 points), the competitive entry year of the 726-point, 6-year MB ChB. Otago quotes later years separately: Years 2-3 $101,567 a year (240 points) and Years 4-6 $116,080 a year (360 points), so the six-year total is about $596,800. Compulsory = 2026 Dunedin Student Services Fee $1,193 for 1 EFTS (2027 not yet published); HSFY is 1.05 EFTS. Excludes insurance. Official page read on 2026-09-30 through a text rendering (r.jina.ai) because otago.ac.nz blocks automated access. 2026 feeHistory row (spreadsheet sheet '2026 Papers'): per-paper basis, Health Sciences First Year (126 points) = the seven 18-point HSFY papers BIOC192, HUBS191, HUBS192 and POPH192 at $6,337.35 each plus CELS191, CHEM191 and PHSI191 at $5,968.05 each = $43,253.55. The spreadsheet has no rows for later MB ChB years (charged separately; not found). Compulsory $1,193 = 2026 Dunedin Student Services Fee. programmes.name: Bachelor of Science (Psychology)
programmes.summary: Estimated yearly tuition for international students majoring in Psychology for 2027. Student services fee included; insurance is extra.
programmes.notes: 2027 estimated international annual fee for a normal full-time BSc (360 points, 3 years) majoring in Psychology ($46,200; the BA Psychology major on the humanities page is $45,360). Compulsory = 2026 Dunedin Student Services Fee $1,193 for 1 EFTS (2027 not yet published). Excludes insurance. Official page read on 2026-10-05 through a text rendering (r.jina.ai) because otago.ac.nz blocks automated access. 2026 feeHistory row (from Otago's '2026 domestic and international tuition fees' spreadsheet, sheet '2026 Papers', read through r.jina.ai): per-paper fees, not a programme fee; 1 EFTS (120 points) = the international fee of an 18-point (0.15 EFTS) PSYC paper, PSYC111 / PSYC112 $6,860.10, x 120/18 = $45,734.00 (fee category IN04). This is a single-subject 1-EFTS rate, whereas the 2027 figure is Otago's estimated annual fee for the programme's normal paper mix, so the two are not like-for-like. No 2024/2025 rows found (as for the other Otago entries). 2024/2025 rows use the same per-paper method as the existing 2026 row, from Otago's per-paper fee spreadsheets for those years (the live asset slot 508756 now serves 2026): '2024-domestic-and-international-tuition-fees.xlsx' (Wayback capture 20240203221503; it has 'International fee' and 'International fee (Grandparented)' columns, and the first, non-grandparented column is used for a new entrant) and '2025-domestic-and-international-tuition-fees-web-version.xlsx' (Wayback capture 20250325224014, linked from the March 2025 International tuition fees page as 'Download the 2025 domestic and international paper fees document'). Both were read on 2026-10-05 through Google Docs viewer's PDF rendering of the Wayback copy, because the Wayback relay will not pass binary files. Compulsory = Dunedin Student Services Fee for 1 EFTS: 2024 '$10.76 per 0.01 EFTS or $1,076.00 per 1 EFTS' (Otago Study/Fees page, Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2024-22 capture 2024-05-21); 2025 '$11.52 per 0.01 EFTS, which amounts to $1,152.00 for 1 EFTS' (otago.ac.nz/study/fees/student-services-fee, Wayback 20250325224013). Tuition: PSYC111 Brain and Behaviour / PSYC112 (18 points, IN04) 2024 $6,282.15, 2025 $6,533.40, x 120/18 = $41,881.00 and $43,556.00. Single-subject 1-EFTS rate, like the 2026 row.
